context:
Goal: a push that would move main by mistake is stopped, not left to an approval prompt.
Problem (rule): your 14:59 CST "Refuse it" was built for an agent's checkout only, so a push of every branch from the main or a lane checkout still asks you, and only you can widen the rule.
Based on (ruling): your 14:59 CST answer "Refuse it", on a push that sends main from an agent's checkout.
Based on (ruling): record plain-push-asks (your 2026-11-03 22:23 CST ruling): --all and --branches pushes ask; this asks whether 14:59 CST replaces that for every checkout.
Based on (read): the guard refuses that push from an agent's checkout; from the main or a lane checkout, a push with --all or --branches still raises an approval prompt, the same as a plain push of main.
Departs from: main (those pushes ask) — option a makes the guard refuse them from every checkout.
Meanwhile: nothing waits; the narrow build is in batch 74 and loosens nothing.

options.gain: No session can send main with a push of every branch, from any checkout.
options.how: A lane makes the guard refuse --all and --branches pushes from every checkout, with the remedy to push the one branch by name.
options.label: Refuse them everywhere (Recommended)
options.lose: A session that truly means to push every branch must push each one by name.

options.how: Nothing changes: those pushes keep raising an approval prompt for you.
options.label: Keep the prompt outside agent checkouts
options.lose: You still get a prompt to judge each such push.

reply: You answered in chat at 16:08 CST (relayed by the coordinator): "I either want it approved or declined whichever is correct. I know for a fact I dont want to be asked." So a push of every branch never asks you. The guard works out what the push would do: it refuses the push when it would update main or master on the remote, and allows it otherwise. Home: record plain-push-asks is rewritten in place, and step push-all-resolve-no-ask builds it once the agent-checkout refusal is on main. (Triage, 16:18 CST.)
title: Does your "Refuse it" also cover a push of every branch from the main or a lane checkout?
why: It settles whether your ruling reaches every checkout or only an agent's.
